svg.title: TCRen scoring routes, inspection examples and contact-graph definitions
svg.desc: Weights use the frozen percentile of cohort-mean pLDDT. Public 1AO7 insets show a groove surface, residue energy attribution and recorded nonzero TCR-peptide contact-type counts. A coloured TCR-peptide-MHC triangle illustrates one cycle and Betti fraction 1/3. A residue r has two contacted side-chain atoms making four atom-pair contacts to two peptide residues, adding two local cycles. r indexes residues, not atoms. Default enrichment uses all observed heavy atoms; side-chain-only counts are a separate diagnostic. Local empirical mock tails are combined as Fisher evidence and calibrated against 2056 whole mock graphs.
